# N059 ideas: synthesis and chosen portfolio
Sources: agents/outsider.md, agents/assumption_breaker.md, agents/codex_ideas.md, agents/codex_diag_redteam.md (+ literature
agents lit_crossbatch.md / lit_noisy_ceiling.md appended when they land). Diagnosis (diagnosis.md, incl. corrections) reproduced.

## What the review established (all reproduced first-hand)
1. Ensembling is closed: test-selected greedy ensemble over 22 members peaks .6922, r_inf fit .693 (M1).
2. The cross-draw shift is real for matched single models (n023_v5 vs in-dist: -.026, AB s3) and concentrates in HLA-DR and the
   pooled panel, but its causes sit in the HELD-OUT LABELS: draw-1 HLA-DR stain near floor and its label tracks the same cell's
   autofluorescence (lymphocytes r -.606 vs +.093 in draw 0; AB s7); the grp:CD45 b01 deficit lives on one dim slide (rep0 .572 vs
   in-dist .656; rep1 .876 vs .869; AB s3) -> per-slide, not per-draw, and not learnable inductively.
3. Inductive upside on those targets <= ~+.01 (AB); monotone recalibration oracle +.0045; few-shot cross-output readout fitted on
   held-out labels reaches .7042 (+.018) but only with >= ~200-500 labelled new-draw cells per target (AB s3 f).
4. Weak markers are few-shot rare-positive problems: CD123 top-1 % cells hold .88-.92 of test variance (M4); CD123 carried 59 % of
   the N053 gain (.0034/.0058) and has seed spread up to .124 (AB s8) -> GOAL noise .0027 understates per-item risk.
5. FOV-level label error still costs ~.04 (within-FOV .726), concentrated in CD19/CD56.

## Chosen portfolio (3 exp items, ~7 GPU-h total, < 25 -> no approval needed)
- N060 (module) = A, N061 (module) = B, N062 (paradigm) = C. Writer: Codex (one brief, three flags in the GOAL harness), Claude red-team
  + integration. Each arm screened with 2 seeds per direction (per-item noise, AB s8), scored on the frozen v10 GOAL and as a 4th
  ensemble member; pre-registered bar: single-model mean over 2 seeds > r50 base (.6730) + .0054, or ensemble > .6862 + .0054.
- Re-scoping options for the user (review #3 without progress beyond ensembling): (1) allow few-shot new-draw readout (D) as a
  second, clearly labelled protocol; (2) keep the inductive GOAL and accept ~.69-.696 as the two-draw ceiling; (3) download the
  BSCCM-coherent set (user OK'd, low expected value) to separate draw from slide effects.

## Literature (agents/lit_crossbatch.md; lit_noisy_ceiling.md pending)
No published inductive fix for a batch-specific fluorescence READOUT: CytoNorm, cyCombine, gaussNorm, CytoVI, AutoSpectral all need
data from the new batch (controls or the batch's own marker data); label-free -> marker papers never vary the readout across their split
(DeepIFC held-out donors share one panel/compensation: CD19 r .61, CD56 .53 on PBMC). BSCCM paper: batch-1 pooled slides got 35 % CD19
antibody; authors call the CD123/CD14/HLA-DR channel "too noisy". Verified first-hand earlier (N038: DeepIFC numbers, 35 % CD19).
Folded in: crowd-layer mixed-effects training -> N061 arm (i); measurement-model pooled heads -> N062. Simulated readout randomisation
(lit idea 3) parked: CPU hedge test on saved predictions first (TODO).

tail/imbalance reweighting and rank regularisers NO (STS-B reproduction: vanilla .766 > LDS .762 / FDS .751 / RankSim .756 / ConR .735),
heteroscedastic Gaussian heads no, self-distillation no gain at ensemble level, local neighbour context yes in spatial transcriptomics
(+.016). Folded in: N060 gets a 3rd arm (MSE + .5 x per-target batch Pearson). Added to TODO: noise-ceiling bracket (unstained floor +
pixel split-half + FOV residual variance; decides reachability) and neighbour-bleed residual test (CPU).

# N066 diagnosis: where the remaining gap (.70 - .6929 descriptive 6-way; - .6862 registered best) lives

Instruments (all on the SAME held-out GOAL cells, v10 labels; 6-way = N065 composite members + N053 members, GOAL .6929):
1. Direction split (n066_perslide.csv): b10 (train draw 1 -> test draw 0) .7036 is already above .70; b01 (train draw 0 -> test
   draw 1) .6822. b01 deficits: grp:CD45 .660 (b10 .779), grp:CD16 .784 (.868), HLA-DR .445 (.525). Draw 0 has ONE 'all' slide
   (10,210 pooled-label cells) vs 27,074 in draw 1.
2. Replicate-slide split inside the b01 test draw (same blood, same stain, same model): grp:CD45 r .881 on 'all' replicate 1 vs
   .578 on replicate 0 (label sd 0.73 vs 1.19; predicted sd .84 vs .84 -> the model sees the same population on both slides).
   grp:CD16: slide label means -.12 vs +.21 while predicted means are +.17 vs +.14 (slide offset not in the image).
3. FOV clustering of the ensemble residual (n066_fovresid.csv, permutation null within draw): excess FOV share CD19 +.46/+.43,
   CD56 +.29/+.30, CD14 b01 +.29, grp:CD45 +.14/+.21, HLA-DR b01 +.17; strong singles ~0 (matches N064 fov_error_share ANOVA).
4. Is the FOV-level residual predictable from LF-observable acquisition context (FOV cell count, within-FOV radius/x/y, focus z
   rel. to slide median)? Cross-draw residual model (fit on the other draw's held-out residuals, HGB): GOAL .6929 -> .6284, every
   target worse; |r(residual, context)| < .1 except draw-specific focus terms -> NOT predictable inductively.
5. Alternative-background labels (n066_altlabels.csv; N064 local-corner-background reconstruction, otherwise the identical v10
   pipeline): the ensemble scores .6652 against local-bg labels alone but .6996 against the CONSENSUS z(v10)+z(local)
   (b10 .7085, b01 .6908); gains on exactly the targets where the two background models disagree: CD56 +.04/+.03, HLA-DR b01
   +.023, CD14 b01 +.021, grp:CD3/19/56 b01 +.014, grp:CD45 +.005/+.011; CD19 is the exception (local-bg CD19 is near noise,
   v10-local r .24-.40, consensus .31/.29 < v10).
6. Re-used: ensemble asymptote ~.693 (N059 greedy test-selected .6922; N065 6-way .6929); pixel noise negligible (N064 r_max .9999);
   within-FOV r of the ensemble +.040 over pooled r (N059); label count 50 -> 100 % lifts weak targets +.035 (K033).

Bottleneck hypothesis: the remaining gap is LABEL error from the fluorescence background model -- FOV-clustered (LOWESS background)
and partly independent between background models -- on the weak/pooled targets, concentrated in b01 (draw 1 'all' replicate 0).
It acts twice: (a) on EVALUATION labels, which no inductive model can fix (instruments 2-4); (b) on TRAINING labels, which limits how
well the shared true signal is learned on weak targets (instrument 5 shows the predictions already track the background-model-
independent component; K033 shows weak targets are still label-starved). Lever (b) is reachable: train on denoised targets
(consensus over background models / reliability-weighted per FOV) while keeping v10 as the evaluation label.
Expected size: (a) caps GOAL near ~.70-.71 for any inductive model on v10; (b) is at most a few hundredths on CD56/HLA-DR/groups.

What would falsify it:
- Training on consensus (v10 + local-bg) targets and scoring on v10 gives no gain on CD56/HLA-DR/grp targets -> training-label
  noise is not limiting (the model already averages it away) and (b) is closed; the remaining gap is then purely (a) + finite data.
- A model whose b01 grp:CD45 r on 'all' replicate 0 rises toward replicate 1 (.88) without seeing draw-1 labels -> the replicate-0
  deficit is image-reachable, not label error.
- If the consensus gain (instrument 5) came from local-bg labels being smoother (lower variance of error on the bright tail)
  rather than independent error, a third background model (e.g. annulus background) would NOT add further consensus gain.

## 2. Allocate gradients using measured background uncertainty

**Mechanism.** Retain v10 training targets. Estimate per-FOV, per-target uncertainty from LOWESS/corner/plane disagreement, using other cells or pixel regions where possible. Apply bounded inverse-uncertainty weights, normalised within target and source intensity strata, with a positive minimum weight. Preserve rare bright examples and report effective independent FOV count.

**Bottleneck / gain.** Residual FOV share exceeds its permutation null by .46/.43 for CD19, .29/.30 for CD56, and b01 .21 for grp:CD45 and .17 for HLA-DR ([FOV measurements](../../n066_fovresid.csv)). ## 3. Morphology microcohorts replace individual noisy examples — CONTRADICTS the unit of supervision

**Mechanism.** Build tight source-LF neighbourhoods separately per measured assay, taking at most one labelled cell per FOV. Predict the cohort's robust measured-label mean from an anchor cell, retaining an ordinary-cell loss to preserve within-cohort biology. Cross-fit neighbourhood construction and choose cohort size on source FOVs. Labels come from actual fluorescence, not teacher predictions; deployment still predicts individual cells.

**Bottleneck / gain.** This averages different fields before fitting. **Mechanism.** From source fluorescence and LF-derived cell masks, compute membrane/interior contrast, radial profiles and boundary-aligned coarse maps in actually stained channels. Then one descriptor auxiliary b01 run, **.5–.7 GPU-h**; reject if frozen-v10 weak-target r stays flat. **2–3 days**. Avoid full fluorescence generation, whose new-draw scalar accuracy was worse (K027).

**Mechanism.** Train LF-derived molecular factors through an assay-conditioned forward model of the six measured fluorescence channels. Separately measured background/shading enters ONLY the training decoder. Single-antibody slides constrain their assayed component plus autofluorescence; pooled slides constrain measured mixtures. Source unstained cells constrain autofluorescence/background, never invented marker-zero labels. Constrain spectra from source measurements, retain a v10 anchor head, and export its individual-cell LF prediction.

**Bottleneck / gain.** N062 panel factors still saw the same scarce curated labels and were flat (.6704). Raw channels/controls add measurements, including readouts discarded by scalar clipping. Shared factors might transfer single-assay information into the 10,210-cell pooled cohort while separating background before asinh. That imbalance and the .080 HLA-DR direction deficit motivate **+.002–.007**; the flat panel result is strong negative evidence ([attempts](../../attempts.md)). This cannot correct unseen draw-specific stain effects.

**Cheapest falsifier / build.** CPU source-FOV forward-model fit: reject unstable spectra or background that absorbs bright-cell signal. Then frozen-inductive-feature decoder fitting (**≤.1 GPU-h**), requiring source-OOF v10 pooled/HLA-DR improvement before end-to-end **.7–1 GPU-h** b01. **3–5 days**. N064 "'`pool_model`/`curate` guide implementation; derive source-only calibrations afresh.

**Order:** screen 1, then 2; pursue 3 if effective label count remains limiting, and 4/5 for richer supervision. Confirm with fresh seeds and FOV-bootstrap differences on frozen v10. b01 grp:CD45 replicate r .578 versus .881, despite similar prediction SD .84, warns that much of the deficit is evaluation error ([per-slide measurements](../../n066_perslide.csv)); none of these ideas guarantees .70.
